name: Xenith
description: Xenith.lol - The BEST vanilla PvP server for PvP practice, duels, wars, and FFAs.

news.title: Xenith Season 3
news.news: A revamp of Xenith with updated maps, game modes, and optimization, giving players a better vanilla PvP experience.

availableGames.title: Mace
availableGames.subtitle: Smash your opponents!
availableGames.description: Fight in parties, duels, or FFAs. Use your mace to smash your opponents and claim victory.

availableGames.title: Bedfight
availableGames.subtitle: Destroy your opponent's bed!
availableGames.description: Attack your opponent's base, destroy their bed, then win the final fight.

availableGames.title: Skywars
availableGames.subtitle: Loot chests and be the last player standing!
availableGames.description: Spawn in the sky, loot chests, gear up, and fight in 1v1s, practice matches, parties, FFAs, and wars.

availableGames.title: Fireball Fight
availableGames.subtitle: Blast your way to victory!
availableGames.description: Use fireballs to reach your opponent's base, destroy their bed, and win the fight.

availableGames.title: Roulette
availableGames.subtitle: Gamble your best kit!
availableGames.description: Put your life on the line with randomized server kits. May the best player win the 1v1!

availableGames.title: Glide
availableGames.subtitle: Glide over the finish line!
availableGames.description: Race in duels, parties, and wars. Take the lead and cross the finish line first!

availableGames.title: Boat Racing
availableGames.subtitle: Slide to victory!
availableGames.description: Row down slippery slopes and cross the finish line ahead of the other players!
